messages.author: 11896ec0d5683d11
messages.subject: Positioning of checkboxes and plots
parts:
To the Shiny makers -very well done. You have done a great job on creating Shiny.
 
Now onto my question...I'm attempting to put a checkboxGroupInput horizontally next to a plot. I've spent a few hours looking around and trying things out but I can't seem to figure out how to put things horizontally adjecent to each other. I've found the following leading me to believe it is possible:
 
https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups#!topic/shiny-discuss/XHGVBWeiiTQ
http://glimmer.rstudio.com/dbets/dBETS/
 
The problems with the solution in the first link is 1) It applies horizontal positioning to ALL radio buttons instead of just a few and 2) I have no idea how to apply it with checkboxes and plots (well, that's my problem - not the answer's problem).
 
The dBETS app seems to show that drop down menus can be placed next to each other but I can't find the source code to it.
 
Bottom line: Does anyone know how to place checkboxes and plots next to each other?
 
Thanks for your help!
Jon

messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: Re: Positioning of checkboxes and plots
parts:
have you tried
div(class="row"),
      div(class="span2", checkboxInput("cb1", "1")),
      div(class="span2", checkboxInput("cb2", "2"))

messages.subject: Re: Positioning of checkboxes and plots
parts:
Without being able to see exactly what is happening it is a bit difficult
If you are putting this in a mainPanel, you have a span of 9 to work with, I believe, so you could try
div(class="row"),
      div(class="span1", checkboxInput("cb1", "1")),
      div(class="span8", plotOutput("plot"))
